name: Feature request

**The workflow it enables**
What you are trying to make, and where the current canvas gets in the way.

**Proposal**
Nodes, ports, parameters or commands involved. Mockups welcome.

**Area**
canvas / graph / exec / providers / media / ui / agent / infra

To work on it yourself, comment `/claim` (CONTRIBUTING.md, "Claiming an issue").
